summary: Grid-search HistGradientBoosting on pilot only (3 lr x 3 tree sizes, early stopping, 5-fold CV)
reasoning: Boost-cv milestone. The label is not linearly separable enough for logistic (0.63), which hints at interactions/nonlinearity thatHistGradientBoostingClassifier should capture. I grid-search on pilot.csv only: learning_rate {0.03, 0.06, 0.1} x max_leaf_nodes {3, 7, 15} with early stopping (validation_fraction 0.25, max_iter 500), 5-fold stratified CV (seed 0, matching the baseline's folds), n_jobs/OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 as required. The chosen config is recorded in out/boost_tune.json (not out/metrics.json) so the shared metrics file keeps only milestone numbers until the cv milestone is confirmed. I expect the best config to reach cv_auc >= 0.80; if nothing clears 0.8 I will widen the grid (max_depth, l2_regularization, min_samples_leaf) rather than touch heldout.csv.
